create_StatsItem_incremental_stats: create a StatsItem to track running mean, std, min, max using the Welford algorithm
create_StatsDict_aggregate_stats: create a StatsDict to aggregate statistics across multiple named keys with incremental updates
test_StatsItem_add_and_query: test StatsItem by adding values and querying mean, std, min, max, and count
build_StatsDict_json_output: build a StatsDict, add values, and serialize all statistics to a JSON string
build_StatsDict_table_output: build a StatsDict, add values, and render a formatted tabulate table of statistics
